definitions.explanation: A person one knows but who is not a close friend.

examples.japanese: {知|し}り{合|あ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{偶然|ぐうぜん}→偶然：02674_guuzen⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I ran into an acquaintance by chance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{知|し}り{合|あ}い⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: He is an old acquaintance of mine.

examples.japanese: {知|し}り{合|あ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{紹介|しょうかい}→紹介：01432_shoukai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけた→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧。
examples.english: I found a job through an acquaintance's introduction.

notes:
{知|し}り{合|あ}い is derived from the verb ⟦{知|し}り{合|あ}う→知り合う：03072_shiriau⟧ (to get to know each other).

DISTINCTION FROM "FRIEND":
- {知|し}り{合|あ}い: acquaintance (someone you know)
- ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧/⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧: friend (closer relationship)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {知|し}り{合|あ}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become acquainted)
- {知|し}り{合|あ}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|とお}して→通す：02300_toosu⟧ (through an acquaintance)
- {知|し}り{合|あ}い⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{知|し}り{合|あ}い (an acquaintance's acquaintance)

USAGE:
Using {知|し}り{合|あ}い to describe someone implies a less close relationship than ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧.
